summary: Frontend-only mobile layout testing on /services/boudoir-shoots at 360x800 and 390x844. Page-level horizontal scroll is prevented (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth because <section> uses overflow-hidden and <body> is overflow-x:hidden), BUT text is still visibly CROPPED at the viewport edge in two sections. The recent fix (text-4xl sm:text-5xl + break-words) did NOT resolve the underlying overflow because the culprit is the grid column gaps, not the font size. Confidential badge and other section headings render fine.

ui_bugs.issue: H2 'Private, unhurried, entirely yours.' overflows and is clipped on the right edge at 360px and 390px viewports. Measured H2 width = 440px inside a container inner-width of only 342px. Section has overflow-hidden which masks the overflow but the last characters of 'yours.' are cut off at the right edge.

H2 'Trust, before anything else.' and the numbered items (01, 02, 03…) are clipped on BOTH edges at mobile widths. Measured H2 width = 528px vs viewport 360/390. The '01', '02' numeric prefixes sit at x<0 (off-screen left) and the last words of the H2 are cut off on the right. Same root cause as About section.
ui_bugs.selector: section (black bg, WHY WOMEN TRUST US) > div.container > div.grid.grid-cols-12.gap-12.md:gap-16

issues: Root cause: Sections use 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-10 md:gap-16' (About) and 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-12 md:gap-16' (Why). With 12 columns and 11 gaps of 40–64px, the minimum grid content-width is 11*40=440px to 11*64=704px. The container inner width on mobile is only ~342px (390 viewport - 24 px-6 each side), so col-span-12 children stretch beyond the container, overflowing the section. Section's overflow-hidden hides horizontal scroll but VISUALLY CROPS the headings.
The .container has computed left=-24 with px-6 (24px) padding, which is fine, but combined with too-large gaps the grid child columns overflow to width 440–528px.
Confidential badge 100% Confidential is fine (right edge at x=390 exactly). Not clipped.

Other section headings (Every detail, A session for every reason, In their own words, Four gentle steps, Quiet elegant frames) render fine because their layouts do not use grid-cols-12 with large gaps in the same way.

action_items: Fix About section grid: change 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-10 md:gap-16' to use a mobile-friendly layout — either 'flex flex-col md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-16' OR keep grid but use 'gap-0 md:gap-16' / 'gap-y-8 gap-x-0 md:gap-16' so mobile stacks without huge horizontal gaps. The col-span-12 child must not exceed the container width.

Fix Why section grid: same treatment for 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-12 md:gap-16'. Ensure the numbered list items (01, 02, ...) do not sit outside the container on mobile — currently the numeric prefix appears to use negative positioning or a col-span-1 that goes negative.
Audit every '<div class=grid grid-cols-12 gap-X>' occurrence in BoudoirPageClient.jsx and switch mobile behaviour to flex-col or reduce mobile gap to 0/2/4.
Consider removing 'overflow-hidden' from these <section> tags AFTER the grid fix so any future overflow becomes visible in testing rather than silently clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: Reducing font-size + adding break-words does NOT fix layout overflow when the parent grid itself is wider than the viewport — the h2 was simply expanding to fill its (already-overflowing) grid column. The recent font-size fix is superficial.
Using 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-16' as the default (without md: prefix on gap) forces mobile viewports into an impossible layout because 11 * 64px = 704px of gap alone.

Multiple <section> elements have 'overflow-hidden' which masks these bugs during casual desktop QA — they only become visible on real mobile devices. Recommend removing overflow-hidden in dev and using a lint/test rule to catch layout overflow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-test the boudoir-shoots page at viewports 360x800 and 390x844 after main agent fixes grid layouts. Verify (a) H2 'Private, unhurried, entirely yours.' bounding box width <= viewport width, (b) H2 'Trust, before anything else.' bounding box width <= viewport width, (c) '01','02','03','04' numbered prefixes in Why section have x >= 0, (d) run the overflow probe: document.querySelectorAll('*') where getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth+1 should return an empty list (currently returns 20+ elements). The page-level scrollWidth check alone is NOT sufficient because parent sections use overflow-hidden.
rca of the issue: In BoudoirPageClient.jsx, the About and Why sections use 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-10' and 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-12' (with md:gap-16). On mobile the container inner width is ~342px but 12 columns with 11 gaps of 40–48px require min 440–528px, forcing children (col-span-12) to be wider than viewport. The section's overflow-hidden then visually crops the H2 text at the right edge. Reproduction: open the URL at 390x844, scroll to 'Private, unhurried, entirely yours.' — the trailing 's.' is clipped; scroll to 'Trust, before anything else.' — 'anything else.' is clipped on right and '01/02/03/04' prefixes are off-screen on left. Mitigation: replace grid-cols-12 gap-X with 'flex flex-col md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-16' on mobile, or set gap-0 md:gap-16.
